svg.title: Растяжка бицепса у стены — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing biceps wall stretch. Side-three-quarter full-body view. Athlete stands turned away from wall surface, one arm extends straight behind the torso at slightly below shoulder height, palm rests flat on the wall, elbow straight. Chest gently turns away, legs steady, free arm relaxed. Clear wall plane and visible palm-to-wall contact. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
